# Flip Image

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Flips an image.

## Syntax

~~~~text
flipImage(image: <#Variable (Optional)#>, mode: <#Enumeration (WFImageFlipDirection)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
flipImage(image: Clipboard, mode: Horizontal)
~~~~
